mainEntity.name: Is Nexcess the same as Liquid Web?

acceptedAnswer.text: TechRadar said Nexcess is now fully absorbed into Liquid Web.

mainEntity.name: How much does Liquid Web managed WordPress cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pro WordPress starts at $19 a month for 50,000 visits. Elite starts at $29 a month.

acceptedAnswer.text: The managed WordPress page we read did not show one. Check the live terms.
